scope: Illustrative local rules and synthetic facts, not C2SIM conformance validation; no order executed

rules.text: @prefix d:<urn:c2sim-validation-demo:>. @prefix math:<http://www.w3.org/2000/10/swap/math#>. { ?r a d:SimulationRequest; d:recipientResolved true; d:startMinute ?s; d:endMinute ?e. ?s math:lessThan ?e. } => { ?r a d:PassesDemonstratedChecks. }. { ?r a d:SimulationRequest; d:recipientResolved false. } => { ?r d:issue d:UnresolvedRecipient. }. { ?r a d:SimulationRequest; d:startMinute ?s; d:endMinute ?e. ?s math:greaterThan ?e. } => { ?r d:issue d:EndBeforeStart. }.
